description: This file defines the NoteEditorActivity class responsible for creating and editing notes within an Android app. It manages UI components, handles user interactions such as saving and deleting notes, and observes a ViewModel for data updates.

classes.name: NoteEditorActivity
classes.description: Activity for creating or editing a note, supporting save and delete operations with user confirmation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, toolbar, and observes the ViewModel for note data.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity, hides delete option if creating a new note.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks, including navigating back or confirming deletion.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input fields, saves the note using ViewModel, and shows feedback.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before deleting the current note via ViewModel.
